description:
BIG-IP AFM single endpoint sweep and single endpoint flood DoS vector configuration states are unexpectedly disabled after updating/upgrading software to BIG-IP 14.1.0 and later.

This issue occurs when all of the following conditions are met:

You updated/upgraded your BIG-IP system to 14.1.0 or later.
You previously configured single endpoint sweep or single endpoint flood DoS.
impact:
After updating/upgrading your BIG-IP system to 14.1.0 or later, both the BIG-IP AFM single endpoint sweep and single endpoint flood DoS vector states are unexpectedly disabled.

Symptoms

As a result of this issue, you may encounter the following symptom:

Protected systems behind the BIG-IP AFM system may receive unexpected traffic.
mitigation:
To mitigate this issue, you can reset the Single Endpoint Sweep and Single Endpoint flood DoS vector configuration states to the previous values before upgrading in both the AFM Device Protection and Protection Profiles (Network Families) vectors.

Note: This mitigation is applicable only if the above DoS vector states were set to any state other than Disabled prior to upgrading to 14.1.0 and later.

Reset configuration states in the AFM Device Protection vector

Go to Security > DoS Protection > Device Protection.
Select Network
Locate Single Endpoint Sweep and Single Endpoint Flood and set the states to the previous settings prior to upgrading. If unsure, set this value to Mitigate.
Optionally, change the default Detection and Mitigation threshold values.
For your changes to take effect, select Commit Changes to System.

Reset configuration states in the AFM Protection Profiles vector

Go to Security > DoS Protection > Protection Profiles.
Select your profile.
Select the Network check box.
Select the Network tab.
Select both the Sweep and Flood vectors and set the states to the previous settings prior to upgrading. If unsure, set this value to Mitigate.
Optionally, change the default Detection and Mitigation threshold values.
For your changes to take effect, select Commit Changes to System.
recommended_actions:
If you are running a version listed in the Versions affected by this issue column, you can eliminate this issue by installing a version listed in the Fixes introduced in column. If the Fixes introduced in column does not list a version for your branch, then no update candidate currently exists for that branch and F5 recommends upgrading to a version with the fix (refer to the table).

If the Fixes introduced in column lists a version prior to the one you are running, in the same branch, then your version should have the fix.

F5 Product Development has assigned ID 1008265 (BIG-IP) to this issue.  This issue has been classified as CWE-754: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions

To determine if your product and version have been evaluated for this issue, refer to the Applies to (see versions) box.
